name: tts-tools
description: Toronto Rising satellite - local TTS Editor plus savefile/xmlbundle libraries

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --prefix packages/xmlbundle && npm run build --prefix packages/savefile
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:editor
scripts.package: npm run build && npm install --prefix packages/tts-editor && npm run vscode:package --prefix packages/tts-editor
